source: Saved A5 exact pre-dopamine checkpoint and A7 target-cohort first-crossing traces. No new historical training replay.
selection_evidence: A7 omitted 300-ms relay sources 48-51 to first-crossing target motor cells 94-96 and moved first crossing 8 ms earlier, not toward no update. The sole complementary structural cohort within this 300-ms bin comprises the same sources to the other nine target motor cells 97-105. This choice is fixed by source bin and destination complement, without using any new probe outcome.
intervention: Apply the real outcome-373 dopamine event through production plasticity and restore only the 36 selected applied weights to pre-update values. Keep the prior 12 target-94-96 300-ms changes and all 432 other plastic-edge changes exactly as in real full. No rescaling, redistribution, modified clipping, new training or production edit.
frozen_probe: Exact A5 32-note panel, fixed cue gains, no exploration and no probe plasticity. The first note and first upward on-threshold crossing are primary; later scores are secondary.
primary_endpoint: First motor on-threshold upward crossing in integer microseconds; compare to saved no-update 372456000 us and full 372383000 us. Moving the crossing later toward no update by at least one 1000-us tick indicates this omitted cohort causally contributes to early threshold timing in this exact combined update. An unchanged, earlier, missing or qualitatively changed crossing is reported without rescue attribution. A near-no timing does not prove individual-edge necessity, sufficiency, or generality.
secondary_endpoints: pre-crossing motor spike batches and readout-window counts
scope_limit: One structural complement test only. No candidate ranking, parameter search, broader training, production-rule change, or fly-circuit claim.
